purpose: Vehicle-scoped battery health, capacity/range history, bounded degradation prediction, charging exposure and independent latest BMS thermal readings.
primaryGoal: Assess pack condition and evidence confidence, understand charging/thermal wear, inspect supporting charts, and choose monitoring or service follow-up without confusing unavailable measurements with healthy or zero values.

dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-keyed inferred analytics, ANALYTICS stale time, retry:false, AbortSignal forwarded. No workspace range argument; the page explicitly describes a lifetime model. Capacity/energy Wh and history range/odometer m remain raw in hook/cache.
dataSources.verification: Source path registration only; backend calculations, completeness, ordering and actual response units not exercised.

dataSources.behavior: Enabled only for positive vehicle IDs; separate live DataState; AbortSignal forwarded; page does not supply refetchInterval. Independent model failure does not hide the thermal panel.
dataSources.verification: Source only; no assertion that latest telemetry is continuously streamed or fresh.

dataSources.owner: Shared ChartContainer annotation flow and annotation hooks
dataSources.behavior: Range chart opts into vehicleId, scope:battery and chartId:battery-health-range-trend. Annotation reads and user-triggered add/delete/hide are capabilities to preserve.
dataSources.verification: Hook source and router registration inspected; no annotation request or mutation executed.

dataSources.endpoint: POST /api/v1/ai/battery/health/narrate (component contract; exact nested route registration not independently traced)
dataSources.routeEvidence: internal\api\router.go:1622,5072 wires the battery health AI handler
dataSources.owner: Existing AI feature gate, stream and AIFeatureCard owners
dataSources.behavior: Optional narrated explanation, not a replacement model. Selected vehicle passed as vehicle_id; scopeKey aborts/clears prior-vehicle output. Mode/feature gates and double-submit protection remain existing owner responsibilities.
dataSources.verification: Source only; no generation, authenticated settings reads or production mutations exercised.

components.decision: reuse; propagate per-source trust into mixed summary rather than invent a new trust state

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Pack health, degradation and cycles recur in operational posture, seven-metric summary, overview gauges and wear bars. This is repeated presentation, not permission to delete distinct context.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep all values and specialist explanations; make the posture the primary summary and subordinate detailed gauges/bars with neutral surfaces, normal-weight secondary labels and less repeated status chrome.

sourceObserved: PageLayout and main Stack preserve full allocated width and min-w-0.
BatteryPanelGrid delegates measured placement to CardGrid.
Trend charts stack then become xl three columns; charging analysis stacks then becomes lg two columns.
Unavailable model branch preserves outline and independent thermal/navigation content rather than hiding the page.

issues.detail: Navigation is forced into two columns even at 320px, with nested fixed-height md Buttons and no label-wrapping strategy. Long localized destinations may require more height/width; overflow and target collisions are not runtime proven.
issues.fix: Use one focusable Link per destination with existing button chrome, min-w-0, wrapping labels and at least 44px target height; consider one column at the narrowest allocated width, retaining all six links.

issues.detail: Charging statistic values are shrink-0 beside wrapping labels; large counts/energy values and 200% text can exceed narrow available width.
issues.fix: Allow a compact stacked row at narrow allocated widths and break/wrap long values without hiding labels or units.

responsive.verification: All ten requested widths, mobile open states, RTL, density and 200% text unverified; no browser session exercised.

sourceObserved: Measured charts supply ariaLabel and corresponding data/dataColumns.
Decorative page/domain icons generally use aria-hidden.
Localized section names, glossary terms and existing shared Review details drawers are retained.
No-model chart frames explicitly justify absence of invented data tables.

issues.detail: Link wraps Button, which unconditionally renders a native button at web\src\components\ui\Button.tsx:66. This is nested interactive content and gives each destination competing link/button semantics.
issues.fix: Render a single native React Router Link using canonical button/link chrome and the localized destination name; retain icon and focus treatment without an inner button.

accessibility.verification: Keyboard navigation, drawer trapping/restoration, screen-reader output, 44px composed targets, effective text/UI contrast, forced colors and reduced-motion behavior unverified.

states.initialLoading: HealthUnavailableOutline receives loading and displays contextual skeletons; main no-model PageLayout sets busy. Independent thermal panel has its own skeleton.
states.empty: No health payload retains summary placeholders, overview/wear, four chart frames, thermal, comparison, insights, statistics, links and recommendations. Health measurement guard rejects the known zero-without-capacity/history sentinel without masking measured zero.
states.fatalError: Main model shows QueryError with refetch; thermal has independent QueryError/retry. Selected-vehicle absence uses NoVehicleSelected.
states.retainedRefreshError: Model StaleRefreshWarning and healthDataState keep source content; summary/comparison mark retained. Thermal independently keeps its own retained payload.
states.offline: LiveStaleDataBanner exists and DataState tracks paused refresh; actual offline behavior was not exercised.

issues.detail: HealthSummary mixes modeled metrics with chargingLive.bms_fullcharge_complete but receives only healthDataState.status for retained. Charging telemetry's own loading/error/freshness is not passed into that mixed summary; latest BMS flag can appear available without its independent trust context.
issues.fix: Pass or compose chargingLiveState-derived trust for the full-charge metric, retaining good model neighbors and the BMS value on refresh failure. Keep independent model and BMS freshness labels rather than declaring the whole strip one period.

issues.detail: useDataState receives no unavailable option for a successful null chargingLive payload. DataState.hasData is data !== undefined (web\src\api\dataState.ts:191), so a resolved null can be classified ok/live even though thermal values are unavailable.
issues.fix: Mark a successfully resolved null telemetry source unavailable using the existing DataState option, preserving unknown versus false/zero and not confusing pending or failed reads with resolved absence.

issues.detail: Missing battery_heater_on correctly displays a dash but takes the green branch of the color ternary, visually implying the same state as a measured false.
issues.fix: Use neutral unknown presentation for null/absent heater readings; only measured on/off may choose a semantic color, and heater-off should not automatically claim battery health success.

visualIssues.detail: Every insight panel receives severity background and border plus colored icon, even positive advice; broad tinted surfaces compete with the primary pack posture and chart evidence.
visualIssues.fix: Keep all insight text/severity identities, but default informational/success cards to neutral shared surfaces. Reserve stronger semantic emphasis for actual warning/critical signals and a small icon or status cue.

visualIssues.detail: Start/end count bars hardcode red/green hex fills; secondary habit readings use fixed emerald/amber/cyan classes at lines 171-181. Session counts are colored like severity despite being descriptive quantities.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse current chart palette/preference contracts for distinct series; render ordinary counts with primary/secondary text tokens and reserve warning colors for documented wear thresholds. Do not change series values, labels, legend persistence or user chart preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Multiple headings use fixed cyan/rose/purple decorative accents; thermal cards assign amber/cyan/purple to routine readings without threshold evidence. Tokens and labels already provide hierarchy.
visualIssues.fix: Use muted/secondary icon tokens for decorative section identity and neutral thermal cards by default; keep semantic color only for a real documented state. Measure composed contrast later rather than assuming these fixed accents are inaccessible.

visualIssues.detail: Range gradient uses opacity 0.3 and two warning/critical reference lines compete with actual/predicted evidence in the adjacent chart (lines 125-126).
visualIssues.fix: Reduce decorative fill/reference-line visual weight using existing chart primitives; retain both thresholds, dashed prediction distinction, actual series visibility and saved palette choices.

architectureIssues.detail: First/latest historical range is labeled Range When New / Range Now although the attached scope explicitly says first/latest available snapshots are not a controlled capacity test. Loss context at line 755 prefixes '-' to an already signed difference, producing '--' for increases.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep raw first/latest range and provenance; describe first/latest observed snapshots rather than asserting factory-new/current measurements, and present the signed change with correct increased/decreased wording using display-only SI conversion.

architectureIssues.detail: Range XAxis uses formatted date labels generated at line 77, but annotation mapper returns timestamp unchanged. Annotation identity and plotted category domain are not normalized the same way; markers risk missing their intended category.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain durable annotation timestamps/IDs and actions; map to the actual chart category using the same date representation or an explicit timestamp domain, without rewriting stored annotations. Verify same-day and timezone cases later.

architectureIssues.detail: Health YAxis is fixed to [60,100] although the main page can represent measured health below 60 and preserve critical service warnings. Actual low-health chart visibility is not exercised.
architectureIssues.fix: Verify axis behavior with measured low values and preserve all actual/predicted points; use a source-aware domain that includes retained evidence and both 70/80 thresholds, with an honest scale rather than clipping severe degradation.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature code imports useCardPlacement directly from the layout-reference implementation path while importing CardGrid from the category barrel.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the canonical layout-category export if available. If the hook is not exported, report a narrowly evidenced category-export need to the layout owner; do not create a second placement implementation or edit shared exports in this page item.

competingImplementations.detail: BatterySpecialistSummary and BatteryEvidenceBrief are typed feature adapters over existing useOperationalMetrics and OperationalBrief, not proven competing formatters or replacement libraries.
competingImplementations.fix: Reuse these adapters and their specialist displays; no new BatteryMetric/Card/Brief framework.

competingImplementations.detail: computeEnergyBreakdown converts raw Wh to kWh for local presentation/export rows using convertEnergyFromSI. This is source-inspected display conversion, not evidence of a hook/cache SI violation.
competingImplementations.fix: Preserve raw SI upstream and current kWh export/display semantics unless an explicitly verified display-preference adoption retains units and all exported values.
